status: Implemented and verified locally; not committed or deployed.
changes: Added COMETA and Receticas de la Casa (Recetanas) to the 21-project jukebox with existing brand assets.
Corrected Pediatría al Día to https://drdariovaldes.com; updated its stack from the current Astro repository.
Normalized Rebeam and Newssies to their verified redirected domains, and Entrena con Inteligencia to its live custom domain.
Curated 63 public resources from 135 synced Chrome bookmarks into six category pages plus an index.
Added bilingual descriptions, accent-insensitive search, topic filtering, alphabetical sorting, empty/reset states and navigation.
Used WhatShips as a catalogue reference with original paper, vermilion, serif and bookmark artwork matching the portfolio.
Added canonical metadata and sitemap entries for the resource pages.

caveats: Local implementation only; no production deploy or commit was performed.
Ten resource destinations returned access restrictions or challenge responses in the automated audit; no full accessibility claim is made for them.
The catalogue is maintained in code, with no remote database or admin editor.
Responsive QA used Chrome viewport emulation, not a physical phone.
Native TypeScript test execution used Node 26; older Node versions without type stripping were not tested.
Existing untracked logo files and existing tmp contents were left untouched.

calibration.claim: Existing project data can add Cometa and Recetanas without changing the jukebox UI.
A typed file-backed catalogue supports the requested searchable category library.
Pediatria points to an unresolving planned domain and should use drdariovaldes.com.
The retired Evolution API documentation path should use the current official documentation root.
Reducing the category heading size fixes its measured overflow at 320 CSS pixels.
